meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你为 DM 渠道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent:解析你的渠道身份、创建 agent 与 DM 消息组并连线,然后通过正常投递路径让 agent 给你发一条欢迎私信。重复运行安全(幂等)。
howto.when: 当渠道凭据已配置、服务正在运行,且已装好至少一个渠道(如 Discord、Slack 等)、适配器已连接时使用。

say.text: 帮我为这个渠道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent
say.note: 我会先问你在哪个渠道、你的用户 ID

say.text: 我的用户 ID 是 123456,显示名和 agent 都叫 Alice
say.note: 据此建 dm-with-Alice 并发欢迎私信

say.text: 欢迎私信一直没到,帮我排查一下
say.note: 我会直接查数据库和日志找原因

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through creating your first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: it resolves your channel identity, wires the DM group to the agent, and sends a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Reruns are safe (idempotent).
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, with at least one channel installed (e.g. Discord, Slack, Telegram) and its adapter connected.

say_en.text: Help me create the first NanoClaw agent for this channel
say_en.note: I'll ask which channel and your user id.

say_en.text: My user id is 123456, display name and agent name are both Alice
say_en.note: Creates dm-with-Alice and sends the welcome DM.

say_en.text: The welcome DM never arrived — help me diagnose
say_en.note: I'll query the DB and logs directly.
